name: Mr Arachnid
info: The Arachnid Aristocrat, the hero who defends New Bristol from its shady underworld

name: Percival Parkinson
info: A smart and spectacled photographic operator for the Daily Bristol, but is there more to this chap than meets the eye?

name: Dr Ignatius Eel
info: A brilliant but dangerous scientist whose experiments merged man with some of the most frightening creatures from the Thames

name: Baron the Hunter
info: After banishment to Africa by his fellow peers in the House of Lords, the Baron has returned with one thing on his mind - revenge

name: The Buzzard
info: After stealing some blueprints for a flying device from some archives in Roma, The Buzzard uses his contraption to rob banks from New Bristol to Oldport

name: Plague
info: After a young researcher was infected by mysterious and powerful disease, his body began to transmutate until the man disappeared, and only Plague remained...

name: Madame Mystery
info: A Romany mystic and gang leader who uses her crystal ball to see into even the darkest corners of New Bristol
